properties.NAME: Unorg. Fed. Terr. 2
properties.CHANGE: The Treaty of Guadalupe-Hidalgo ended the Mexican War and changed the boundary between the U.S. and Mexico. That part of the former Republic of Mexico in present Colorado became unorganized federal territory.
properties.CITATION: ("Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo," New Handbook of Texas, 6:558-559; Parry, 102: 29-59; U.S. Stat., vol. 9[1848]/pp. 922-943)
